pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-rectangular patches with rounded vertices. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients. Darker pigmentation is concentrated at patch centers with slight lightening toward the edges.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned interstitial pathways forming a complete topological graph. Corridor width is non-uniform, showing significant narrowing at the junctions near the dorsal ridge compared to the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the neck and upper back, representing a continuous mane of short vertical hairs.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Textural disruption and nodular hyper-pigmentation visible on the lateral-ventral neck and shoulder region, appearing as raised, irregular dark clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a single avian subject (oxpecker) perched on the posterior dorsal ridge.
